text:
Maya (support): Heads up — we've received 3 customers complaining about answer quality since yesterday's canary. All mention shorter, less detailed answers and a few hallucinations.

Sophia (customer): example from Acme: asked for step-by-step DB migration and got a single line suggestion + wrong command. They attached logs.

Maya (support): Reproduced locally against canary stack. Tone is flatter, lots more omissions. Rolling back for Acme fixed it.

Jordan (product): Which rollout id/flag? We need to know scope and canary pct.

DeployBot: canary-deploy r2026-07 started — targets: api-region-us, rollout 18% — feature: draft_decode_v2 (speculative decoding)

Anika (eng-ml): Looks like draft_decode_v2 enabled a new sampler heuristics change. It prioritizes shorter candidate drafts to reduce tokens. That explains the brevity.

Carlos (eng-runtime): Confirmed in the request logs: header x-features: "draft_decode=enabled, sampler=short-pref" and config snippet: ```json
{
  "sampler": "spec_draft_v2",
  "max_drafts": 3,
  "draft_budget": 0.25
}
```

Noah (sre): Latency improvement is real — p95 down ~40ms. But we can't trade correctness for a marginal latency gain for these customers.

Maya (support): Customers impacted: Acme, BrightPath, and FinNova. All high-touch. BrightPath says regression started at ~2026-03-02 15:40 UTC.

Jordan (product): Action items: 1) immediate targeted rollback for impacted customers, 2) gate the draft heuristic behind a stricter quality threshold, 3) add evals on our core prompt set before canary promotion.

Anika (eng-ml): Agreed. Quick repro: call endpoint with param `draft_mode=on` vs `off` for the same prompt. Example prompt and responses attached below. Running CI-local eval shows BLEU/QA drop ~12 points on our doc QA suite when draft_budget <=0.3.

Carlos (eng-runtime): For rollback I can flip the feature flag for specific account IDs. Can we get a list of account IDs?

Maya (support): Providing IDs now in DM. Also adding the customer repro steps and minimal prompt that triggers the brevity.

Sophia (customer): Appreciate the quick response. We need a fix before EOD or we'll need to pause calls.

Anika (eng-ml): Longer-term: tune the draft scoring to bias for completeness for instruction-like prompts. Short-term: set draft_budget=0.5 and max_drafts=5 for canary. That should recover length/coverage.

Carlos (eng-runtime): Rolling the targeted flag change now for Acme and BrightPath. Will monitor errors and quality traces.

DeployBot: feature-flag update applied to account Acme (acct_9301) and BrightPath (acct_1129) at 1769801830

Noah (sre): Monitoring dashboards: adding a temporary QC alert for our instruction prompt set — trigger if quality delta > 8% across canary.

Maya (support): Sending customers the rollback note and interim mitigation settings. Keeping FinNova on watch until we can patch sampler.

Jordan (product): For postmortem we need: rollout checklist gap, missing evals, and proposal for automatic canary-quality gates. Assigning to @Anika and @Carlos.

Anika (eng-ml): Will run a focused regression test against the top 50 customer prompts and report by EOD.

Carlos (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a hotfix config and a safe default that disables the short-pref sampler unless explicitly allowed.

Maya (support): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with customer status updates and paste logs into the ticket. :thumbsup:

Sophia (customer): thanks, staying on standby. 

Maya (support): closing loop here once Anika/Carlos confirm stable defaults.
